subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned, locked PR-limit announcement remain open as the public policy reference now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced?
rationale: Current code and docs already implement the policy, but a maintainer later renamed, pinned, and reopened this issue, so cleanup automation should not close the announcement without human intent.

options.title: Keep pinned announcement
options.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned while the hard 20-PR cap remains an active contributor policy.

options.title: Use docs only
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide the contribution guide should be the sole public policy surface for the PR cap.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned announcement
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned while the hard 20-PR cap remains an active contributor policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the rename, pin, and reopen actions that made the issue a live public policy artifact.
